_about: A model of OneLake settings. tenant holds two tenant settings; workspace holds the OneLake tab's shortcut cache. expectations records what you expect the cache to do.
needs: Analysts browse lakehouse files from Windows with the OneLake file explorer app.
The workspace reads an Amazon S3 shortcut many times a day; cut repeated egress by caching it, keeping cached files for a week after they were last read.
One file behind the shortcut, sensor_dump.parquet, is 3 GB.
